description: Canonical concept taxonomy for the PuniCodex cross-cultural similarity graph. Maps raw relationship strings to clean, non-overlapping concept arms grouped by domain.

thunder-storm-sovereignty.label: Thunder / Storm Sovereignty
thunder-storm-sovereignty.description: Sky and storm sovereigns who command thunder, lightning, and the celestial order.

sun-light.label: Sun / Light
sun-light.description: Solar deities and bringers of light, clarity, and cosmic radiance.

moon-lunar.label: Moon / Lunar
moon-lunar.description: Lunar powers that govern cycles, tides, night-vision, and monthly rhythm.

sea-water.label: Sea / Water
sea-water.description: Rulers of oceans, rivers, and the primordial waters that precede creation.

fire-craft-inspiration.label: Fire / Craft / Inspiration
fire-craft-inspiration.description: Fire-bearers, smiths, poets, and illuminators of sacred knowledge.

earth-fertility.label: Earth / Fertility
earth-fertility.description: Earth mothers, fertility powers, and regenerative forces of vegetation.

death-underworld-rebirth.label: Death / Underworld / Rebirth
death-underworld-rebirth.description: Guides of souls, rulers of the dead, and powers of cyclical return.
relationships: Queen and king of the underworld

healing-medicine.label: Healing / Medicine
healing-medicine.description: Physicians of the divine, masters of herbs, incantations, and restorative arts.

war-battle.label: War / Battle
war-battle.description: Warriors, battle-frenzies, and protective destroyers who decide the fate of armies.

hunt-wilderness.label: Hunt / Wilderness
hunt-wilderness.description: Masters of beasts, forests, and the untamed margins of the known world.

love-beauty-desire.label: Love / Beauty / Desire
love-beauty-desire.description: Powers of attraction, eros, beauty, and the longing that moves gods and mortals.

trickster-mischief.label: Trickster / Mischief
trickster-mischief.description: Boundary-breakers, shape-shifters, and sacred fools who upset cosmic order.

wisdom-knowledge.label: Wisdom / Knowledge
wisdom-knowledge.description: Keepers of lore, writing, secret speech, and the architecture of understanding.

justice-law-truth.label: Justice / Law / Truth
justice-law-truth.description: Arbiters of cosmic law, moral order, and the binding truth beneath custom.

messenger-travel-commerce.label: Messenger / Travel / Commerce
messenger-travel-commerce.description: Divine messengers, psychopomps, travelers, and negotiators of exchange.

guardian-protector.label: Guardian / Protector
guardian-protector.description: Watchers at the threshold who defend cities, souls, and sacred boundaries.

creator-cosmogonic.label: Creator / Cosmogonic
creator-cosmogonic.description: Architects of worlds, weavers of the first matter, and originators of being.

chaos-primordial.label: Chaos / Primordial
chaos-primordial.description: Forces of pre-creation chaos, primordial monsters, and the disorder that precedes form.

fate-time.label: Fate / Time
fate-time.description: Weavers of destiny, measurers of age, and powers that bind past to future.

dawn-morning.label: Dawn / Morning
dawn-morning.description: Heralds of the returning sun, dawn-dancers, and bringers of first light.

divine-kinship.label: Divine Kinship
divine-kinship.description: Sacred pairs, divine fathers and sons, twins, and the lineage of immortals.
relationships: The Vǫlsunga cycle: brothers divided by the hoard
The Vǫlsunga cycle: foster-father and foster-son
Power and the god it animates
Strong hand opens the cave of the sun

identity-tradition-forms.label: Identity / Tradition Forms
identity-tradition-forms.description: One figure under two names — the same deity carried across traditions and scripts.
relationships: Krishna as Lord of the World

supreme-sovereign.label: Supreme Sovereign
supreme-sovereign.description: Highest celestial rulers and supreme father-gods who preside over pantheons and cosmic law.

wealth-prosperity.label: Wealth / Prosperity
wealth-prosperity.description: Deities of fortune, wealth, abundance, and the prosperity of households and kingdoms.

compassion-savior.label: Compassion / Savior
compassion-savior.description: Bodhisattvas and savior powers whose defining work is mercy, rescue, and liberation from suffering.
relationships: Pure Land savior and bodhisattva of compassion

sleep-dream.label: Sleep / Dream
sleep-dream.description: Powers of sleep, dream, and the liminal night-state between waking and death.

sacred-center.label: Sacred Center / Axis Mundi
sacred-center.description: Sacred places, objects, and world-trees regarded as the navel or axis of the cosmos.
relationships: Sacred center / world navel / axis mundi
Strength god and the sacred gorge

soul-life-force.label: Soul / Life Force
soul-life-force.description: Personifications and concepts of the soul, breath, ka, ba, and animating spirit.

divine-feminine-power.label: Divine Feminine Power
divine-feminine-power.description: The active, fierce, and creative power of the divine feminine — śakti, destruction, and protection.
